decisions.reason: The reference-class electrometer is a flagship that sits at the core of the firm's dosimetry competence and was featured on the home page, so its results meet aspirations and there is no trigger for problemistic search to drop it.

The oncology risk management software fits the firm's strategy of converging machine and patient QA, and its slack from a broad, R&D-intensive portfolio lets the firm carry a product whose early results are still uncertain rather than drop it after one year.
